cards.card_text: As he walks up the road, a group of boys comes out of the city and jeers at him, chanting, "Go up, you baldhead!
cards.verse_text: From there, Elisha went up to Bethel, and as he was walking up the road, a group of boys came out of the city and jeered at him, chanting, “Go up, you baldhead!
